title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - CommunicationInterface
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/CommunicationInterface. An interface defines which primitive operations and services the lower layer makes available to the upper one, when referring to network layers (definition adapted from Tanenbaum, Computer Networks, 4th ed.). Subclass of saref4syst:ConnectionPoint (SAREF4SYST, out of this candidate's scope; carries no properties translated here). Used as the range of usesCommunicationInterface from saref:Device/saref:DeviceKind entities (e.g. Lamppost, WasteProcessingDevice and its subclasses).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CommunicationInterface'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
